sql.text:
WITH youngest_driver AS (
    SELECT driverid
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_qualifying_race AS (
    SELECT q.driverid, MIN(r.date) as first_race_date
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid
    WHERE q.driverid = (SELECT driverid FROM youngest_driver)
    GROUP BY q.driverid
)
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fqr.first_race_date)::int AS year,
    r.name,
    r.date,
    r.time
FROM first_qualifying_race fqr
JOIN races r ON fqr.first_race_date = r.date
JOIN youngest_driver yd ON fqr.driverid = yd.driverid
LIMIT 1;
